en.topic_title: NGO concerned about South China Morning Post reporter Minnie Chan, 3 years after apparent disappearance
en.topic_summary:
Free expression NGO Reporters Without Borders (RSF) has expressed concern over the apparent disappearance of South China Morning Post (SCMP) reporter Minnie Chan close to three years ago.



SCMP reporter Minnie Chan. Photo: Facebook.



Chan reported on defence issues, but was last heard from in October 2023 while she was covering the Xiangshan Forum, a three-day security conference, in Beijing.



The French NGO said that there has been no news of the whereabouts of the award-winning reporter
